description: A principal must approve the plan for the school's annual emergency evacuation exercise and finalize its format, assembly area, medical support, student alternatives, and family notification procedures, with input from the school nurse, school counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The school's annual emergency evacuation exercise must be completed during the fall term.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan gives final approval to the exercise plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan calls for a standard evacuation alarm, assembly in the east courtyard, and a general family notice.
shared_context.S4: School policy requires the principal to review the exercise plan with the nurse, counselor, facilities manager, and family liaison before approval.

PF1.text: A student's current seizure action plan requires a nurse or trained backup to accompany the student during any evacuation exercise and requires a designated medical-support station at the assembly area. Nurse Ellis confirmed the plan with the student's family this week, but the exercise draft has not been updated.

PF2.text: Two students have documented trauma accommodations requiring an announced walkthrough instead of a surprise alarm exercise, with a supervised opt-out location for either student who cannot participate. Ms. Shah reviewed the accommodations this week, but they are not yet recorded in the exercise plan.

PF3.text: The east courtyard is closed for resurfacing during the exercise window, and the fire marshal has approved the west field as the temporary assembly area. Mr. Benton received the closure and approval confirmation this week, but the facilities copy of the draft still lists the east courtyard.

PF4.text: The district family-notification procedure requires at least 72 hours of advance notice for this exercise, with notices available in Spanish, Somali, and Vietnamese. Ms. Okafor confirmed the language requirement with the district translation office this week, but the draft only says that a general notice will be sent.

acceptance_conditions: The exercise must use an announced walkthrough rather than a surprise alarm exercise.
The west field must be the assembly area.
A medical-support station must be provided and a nurse or trained backup must be assigned.
Students covered by trauma accommodations must have a supervised opt-out location.
Families must receive notice at least 72 hours before the exercise.
The notice must be available in Spanish, Somali, and Vietnamese.
The plan must include a formal commitment to provide a supervised opt-out location for students covered by trauma accommodations.
The plan must include formal facilities-assembly and multilingual-notification commitments.

content_checks.C1: 'announced walkthrough' in decisions['exercise_format'] or 'Announced walkthrough' in decisions['exercise_format']
content_checks.C2: 'west field' in decisions['assembly_area'] or 'West field' in decisions['assembly_area']
content_checks.C7: 'Spanish' in decisions['notice_languages'] and 'Somali' in decisions['notice_languages'] and 'Vietnamese' in decisions['notice_languages']
content_checks.C9: any('supervised opt-out location' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('west field' in c['detail'] and 'assembly area' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or any('West field' in c['detail'] and 'assembly area' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or any('west field' in c['detail'] and 'assembly area' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any('72-hour' in c['detail'] and 'Spanish' in c['detail'] and 'Somali' in c['detail'] and 'Vietnamese' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) or any('72 hours' in c['detail'] and 'Spanish' in c['detail'] and 'Somali' in c['detail'] and 'Vietnamese' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The seizure action plan changes the medical provisions from no designated station or assigned medical escort to both a medical-support station and a nurse-or-backup assignment.
The trauma accommodations change the exercise format from a standard surprise alarm to an announced walkthrough, require a supervised opt-out location, and add a commitment describing that location.
The resurfacing closure and fire-marshal confirmation change the assembly area from the east courtyard to the west field and require an assembly-area update commitment.
The district notification procedure changes the family notice to at least 72 hours in advance and requires Spanish, Somali, and Vietnamese versions plus a multilingual-notification update commitment.
